# yang

> A pure-Go YANG library (no cgo): an AI-assisted source port of libyang v5.8.6 that aims to give the same verdicts, diagnostics and output as libyang for the same schemas and data. Module `github.com/vibe-ports/yang`, v0: the API is unstable and may change in any release, so pin a version.

- Install: `go get github.com/vibe-ports/yang`. Needs Go 1.26 or newer. No C toolchain, libyang or libpcre2.
- Agreement with libyang is measured on a fixture corpus with a test-only C oracle; any difference not listed in the deviations registry is a bug.
- Package `yang` loads and compiles schemas; package `data` (`github.com/vibe-ports/yang/data`) handles instance data.

## Main API flow

- Schema: `yang.NewContext(yang.Options{...}, fsys...)` (modules come from `fs.FS` directories) returns `(*Context, []Diagnostic, error)`; `ctx.Load(name, revision, features)` loads and compiles a module and returns `([]Diagnostic, error)`; `ctx.Schema()` returns an immutable `*yang.Schema` snapshot, safe to share between goroutines.
- Data: `data.Parse(ctx, reader, data.FormatJSON | data.FormatXML, schema, data.ParseOptions{})` returns `(*Tree, []yang.Diagnostic, error)` and validates unless `ParseOptions.ParseOnly` is set; `tree.Validate(ctx, data.ValidateOptions{})` re-validates; `tree.PrintJSON(w, data.PrintOptions{})` and `tree.PrintXML(w, ...)` print, with-defaults modes are `data.WDExplicit`, `data.WDAll`, ...
- Diagnostics: `yang.Diagnostic` carries libyang's LY_ERR and LY_VECODE names, data path, schema path and error-app-tag. A failed data call returns `*data.ValidationError` (field `Diags`).
- Errors: `errors.Is(err, yang.ErrUnsupported)` means input the port does not handle yet; `errors.Is(err, yang.ErrBudget)` means a resource limit was hit (`yang.ParseBudget`, `data.Budget`).

## Status

- [README status table](https://github.com/vibe-ports/yang/blob/main/README.md#status): what is supported, partial and unsupported (for example `deviation` statements, anydata, RPC/action/notification data, full diff and yang-library are unsupported today). Read it before assuming a libyang feature exists.

## Behaviour differences

- [Deviations registry](https://github.com/vibe-ports/yang/blob/main/conformance/deviations.md): D-* entries are intentional differences from libyang (where libyang contradicts the RFC, crashes or depends on the host; "(candidate)" means libyang is mirrored for now); the "Known libyang behaviour (mirrored)" section lists libyang quirks the port copies. U-* entries are unsupported features of this port: a U-* limit means the port refuses the input (usually `ErrUnsupported`), not that libyang differs.
